name: Tamami Fuuko
source:
Area: Ehime Prefecture

A girl who came to visit the hospital to see her grandmother with a fruits basket in her hands. Because the basket is heavy however, she takes breaks, and even had to take a night bus from another region so she could go see her.

Fuuko happens to stop and take a break at an unfortunate time as [url=/c70696]Shigeru[/url] approaches her...
